reason: A browser-only chat sidebar plugin that provides a visual timeline for user messages, hover previews, and click-to-jump navigation without external services, polling, routes, or tools.

summaries.zh: 在聊天侧边栏显示用户消息时间线，支持悬停预览和点击跳转到对应消息。
summaries.en: Adds a chat-sidebar message timeline with hover previews and click-to-jump navigation.

capabilities: Adds a browser-only timeline rail to the chat sidebar
Reads displayed user-message anchors and content for navigation and hover previews
Smooth-scrolls to selected user messages and applies a visual highlight
